spec.applies_when: day.sessions.length >= 2. n == 1 renders the existing single SessionCard full-width (gutter to gutter, ~358px at 390) with no rail, no index, no scroll container. n == 0 renders the rest block only.

geometry.page_gutter: 16px (existing px-4); card text aligns to the same 16px optical gutter
geometry.card_width: calc(100vw - 68px) = viewport - 16 left gutter - 12 gap - 40 peek; clamp(264px, calc(100vw - 68px), 420px). 320->264 (peek 28), 390->322 (peek 40), 430->362 (peek 40).
geometry.peek: 40px at >=360px, 28px at 320px. The peek exposes the next card's 24px spine + 16px body padding: an edge and a hanging dossier tab, never a truncated word or half glyph.
geometry.gap: 12px (intra-group token) — flex gap and scroll-snap gutter at once
geometry.card: 12px radius, 1px --hairline, --paper ground, no shadow, no elevation, no scale on snap
geometry.row_height: equal height set by the tallest card (flex row, align-items:stretch; card flex:0 0 auto; display:flex column). Equal height is what keeps the action row on one baseline across snaps.
geometry.full_bleed: scroll container margin-inline:-16px; padding-inline:16px; scroll-padding-inline:16px. Never width:100vw (scrollbar overflow), never a transform track.
geometry.trailing_space: padding-inline-end:16px so the last card can rest at the gutter

snap.stop: scroll-snap-stop:always (one session per gesture, no fly-through)
snap.padding: scroll-padding-inline:16px so snapped cards land on the page gutter
snap.overflow: overflow-x:auto; overflow-y:hidden; overscroll-behavior-x:contain — the page never scrolls sideways and vertical page scroll still wins on diagonal gestures
snap.touch_action: leave default (pan-x pan-y). Do NOT set touch-action:pan-x: it locks vertical scrolling inside the region on Android.
snap.scrollbar: hidden (scrollbar-width:none; ::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}) — the tick rail is the honest position read
snap.engine: native overflow scrolling, no JS carousel, no transform track, no pointer capture
snap.n1_fallback: one card: display:block, no overflow, no snap, no tabindex, no rail

card_anatomy.spine: 24px fixed left column, 1px --hairline right edge, 2px modality bar on the outer left edge (--signal running / --steel strength = mark and edge only, never a fill). Vertical mono ordinal 01/02, 10px, --steel, writing-mode:vertical-rl, aria-hidden (the ordinal lives in the accessible name).
card_anatomy.body_padding: 16px top/right/left; 0 bottom (the action row owns its 16px)
card_anatomy.row_1: eyebrow: mono 10px/12px uppercase, letter-spacing .12em, --steel; modality + intensity ladder. Right: session type + logged tick, mono, --signal-ink.
card_anatomy.row_2: title: Space Grotesk 17px/22px, weight 500, --ink, wraps to 2 lines maximum, no ellipsis on session names.
card_anatomy.rule: 1px --hairline across the body, 12px above and below
card_anatomy.row_3: two data cells: mono 22px/22px numeral + mono 10px/12px --steel caption (prescribed / target). Fixed 2 columns, never 3 at <=360px.
card_anatomy.row_4: one detail line, mono 12px/16px: pace band / zone / RPE, --steel; amber only via --signal-ink for 'at goal pace'.
card_anatomy.density_guard: no exercise list inside the card. Strength shows '5 machines / 3 x 10' and the full list lives in the sheet after Start or Log. This is what keeps cards equal height.

action_row.position: inside the card, pinned bottom by margin-top:auto, separated by a 1px --hairline 12px above it. Never sticky, never floating, never overlapping the peek, never duplicated outside the snapped card.
action_row.baseline: identical y across cards because of equal card height — the primary does not jump when snapping
action_row.primary: one filled --ink button, 44px tall, radius 8px, --paper label, 14px/500 IBM Plex Sans, flex:1, label 'Start'. Only when prescription.workout exists.
action_row.secondary: 'Log' ghost: 44px, 1px --hairline-strong, --ink label, radius 8px, min-width 88px. Becomes 'Edit log' when a log exists.
action_row.logged_state: replaces the row: mono 12px logged line ('Logged · 5.0 km · 4:41 /km') left, 'Edit log' ghost right. No Start on a completed session, no dimmed-but-tappable ghost of one.
action_row.no_workout: single full-width 'Log' — never an empty Start slot
action_row.press: background/opacity change only, 90ms; no scale, no ripple

indicators.honesty_rule: a position read exists only at n>=2. At n==1 rail and index are unmounted, not hidden with opacity or visibility.
indicators.rail: 12px below the card row, aligned to the 16px gutter. One tick per session: inactive 12x2px --hairline-strong, active 24x2px --signal (mark, not fill, not text). 2px between ticks. Ticks are not buttons.
indicators.state_source: active index = scrollLeft rounded to the nearest snap point; the rail reflects position, it does not decorate it.
indicators.why_not_dots: dots imply a gallery and lie at n==1; a tick rail reads as a scale, matches the instrument language, and encodes count as length.

focus.ring: 2px --ink, offset 2px on --paper; inside ink-filled buttons a 2px --paper inner outline keeps the ring visible
focus.scroll: focusin on any card -> scrollIntoView({inline:'start', block:'nearest'}) so keyboard users never operate an off-screen card
focus.order: DOM order == visual order == plan order (run before strength). Never reorder by logged state.

carousel.desktop:
>=720px: the carousel is deleted, not restyled.
- the track becomes a grid on the page gutter (no full-bleed margins): repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap 12px; content max 672px (page max-w-2xl) -> 314px cards.
- 3+ sessions: the same 2-column grid wraps (never 3-up before 1080px; at >=1080 repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px,1fr)) up to 3).
- no peek, no negative margin, no overflow, no snap, no tabindex, no rail, no index counter — the whole set is visible, so a position read would be noise.
- single session at >=720: do not stretch the card to 672px of body text; cap it at 420px and leave the second column empty.
- equal height within a row (grid stretch); action rows stay bottom-aligned; no hover lift — hover only darkens the 1px border to --hairline-strong.
- the day header (MONDAY / 2 SESSIONS / 50 MIN) stays above the set at both breakpoints and is the only place the count is stated in words.
a11y: Wrapper at n>=2: role='region' aria-roledescription='carousel' aria-label="Today's sessions, 2 of 2". At n==1 there is no wrapper role.
Each card: role='group' aria-roledescription='slide' aria-label='1 of 2: Running, Threshold 5 x 1 km'. The 01/02 spine is aria-hidden so it is not read twice.
Track tabindex='0' only at n>=2; ArrowRight/Left move one card, Home/End first/last via scrollTo, with snap doing the landing. No custom track.
Polite live region announces 'Session 2 of 2' once after settle (scrollend, or a 120ms debounce fallback) — never per frame or per pixel.
Off-screen cards stay in the DOM and the tab order (not aria-hidden); focus is followed by a scroll, so the focused card is always the snapped one.
No horizontal page scroll: body overflow-x:clip; the full-bleed effect is margin+padding, never width:100vw; overscroll-behavior-x:contain on the track.
Vertical page scroll is preserved: default touch-action, no wheel hijack, no pointer capture, no drag listeners.
prefers-reduced-motion: programmatic moves use behavior:'auto'; native swipe still snaps because snap is layout, not animation.
Targets inside the card are 44px tall; the Log ghost is >=88px wide; no icon-only control in the carousel.
200% text zoom: card width is viewport-derived so the peek ratio holds; height grows (no fixed height); the 2 data cells may stack at <=280px content width.

Contrast: --steel on --paper 5.47:1, --steel on --sunken 5.13:1, --signal-ink on --paper 5.30:1, --hairline-strong on --paper 3.11:1 (non-text edges only). --signal is only ever a 2px mark (edge, tick, notch) — never text, never a button fill, never a selected fill.
RTL: scroll-snap-align:start plus logical padding flips without a second stylesheet; the peek stays on the inline-end side.

tabbar.wire:
ruler, not an app bar: one hairline, three ticks, one notch

+------------------------------------------------+
|        ====                                    |
|        |                .-.              |     |
|        |--             ( o )            |||    |
|      TODAY            COACH          PROGRESS  |
|................................................|
|          safe area: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)|
+------------------------------------------------+

marks 20x20 / stroke 1.5 / square caps; labels mono 10 caps
the 32x2 --signal notch straddles the top hairline and slides

spec.structure: <nav aria-label='Primary'> > ul (3 li) > a href. Fixed order Today / Coach / Progress. aria-current='page' on the active link; the nav is the only fixed element in the app.
spec.bar: fixed inset-inline:0; bottom:0; z-index:20. 1px --hairline top edge; background color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper) 93%, transparent) + backdrop-filter: blur(12px). No shadow, no floating capsule, no rounded top corners, no border on the sides.
spec.row_height: 56px content row + env(safe-area-inset-bottom). Each tab is 1/3 of the width and the whole cell (mark + label) is the hit target: ~130x56 at 390, ~106x56 at 320 — above 44x44 everywhere.
spec.label: IBM Plex Mono 10px/12px, uppercase, letter-spacing .12em, weight 400, one line, no truncation. Active --ink, inactive --steel (5.47:1 light / 7.07:1 dark on paper). Labels always visible: this bar is never icon-only.
spec.mark_size: 20x20 inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 20 20, stroke currentColor 1.5, fill none, stroke-linecap:square, stroke-linejoin:miter. Square caps read as instrument; rounded caps read as consumer app.

marks.today: day notch: M10 4 V16 + M10 6.5 H16. Silhouette = line; reads as a marker on a rule.
marks.coach: reticle: circle(10,10,6.25) + ticks M10 1.5V3.75, M10 16.25V18.5, M1.5 10H3.75, M16.25 10H18.5. Silhouette = circle.
marks.progress: ladder: three 2px bars, x=4 y=12..16, x=9 y=8..16, x=14 y=4..16, fill currentColor no stroke. Reuses the IntensityLadder vocabulary already in the product. Silhouette = bars.

spec.mark_color: currentColor only: --ink active, --steel inactive. Never --signal on a mark except the notch.
spec.layout: flex column, align-items:center, gap:4px, padding:7px 0 5px. No dividers between tabs — the ruler reads continuous; the notch is the only separator.
spec.page_clearance: main padding-bottom: calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 24px). Delete the footer domain line that currently sits under the fixed bar.

tabbar.active:
Active state = position on a scale, not a pill:
- a 32x2px --signal bar centred on the bar's top hairline (top:-0.5px, covering the 1px --hairline), square ends.
- it slides horizontally to the active tab: 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); the only amber on the bar.
- mark and label go --ink; inactive stay --steel. Weight does not change (mono 400 both) so nothing reflows.
- never colour-only: aria-current='page' + notch + ink label.
- no filled tab, no label underline, no badge dot, no icon scale.
- on SPA route change the notch moves; no page fade, no cross-fade of tab content.
tabbar.safe_area:
- <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover'> is required or env() is always 0 and the bar collides with the home indicator.
- the bar's background (paper/93 + blur) paints through the inset: padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); the inner row stays 56px, so the indicator floats on the same ground rather than a separate strip.
- nothing interactive in the inset: no 4th control, no handle, no drag affordance.
- landscape: pad the inner row by max(0px, env(safe-area-inset-left)) and right so the outer tabs clear the notch.
- sheets (LogSheet, SessionPlayer, Settings) render above the bar; while one is open the nav gets inert + aria-hidden so focus cannot land behind the scrim. When a sheet has an input the bar is hidden, so visualViewport resizing never moves it.
- PWA standalone: same insets. Verify 0 / 0 / 34px.
a11y: nav aria-label='Primary' wrapping a 3-item list; aria-current='page' on the active link. Marks are aria-hidden with no <title>; the visible label is the accessible name.
Three targets at 1/3 width x 56px; 106px wide at 320px — no target below 44x44.
Labels are always shown; no icon-only mode, no tooltip dependency.
The notch is decorative (aria-hidden). State is carried by aria-current and ink-vs-steel, never by amber alone.
Focus: 2px --ink ring, offset 2px, visible on both themes; only :focus-visible is styled.
The bar is a sibling of main, never inside it, and main reserves its height so no card action row is ever clipped.
No announce on tab press: navigation moves focus to the page h1. No 'tab 2 of 3' chatter, no live region.
Reduced motion: the notch jumps instead of sliding.
Forced colors: 1px hairline becomes CanvasText, notch becomes Highlight, blur/backdrop is dropped.
Press feedback: opacity .7 over 90ms; no scale, no ripple.

week.wire:
+------------------------------------------------+

          |     |                 |
    |     |     |                 |
    |     |     |    --     |     |    --
|________==______________________________________|
   MO    TU    WE    TH    FR    SA    SU
   45    60    50    -     30    62    -
   x     x     x*          *
+------------------------------------------------+

WE selected: cell returns to --paper inside the well
TU today: 2px --signal rule on the cell bottom (==)
-- rest: 2px --hairline tick, never an empty cell
x logged / * planned / x* one of two done
keep: Week pager semantics (Week N of M, prev/next, disabled at the ends) — collapsed from its own band into the header line as mono 'W3/12  < >' with 44px hit areas.
The week focus line (Space Grotesk 24px) and ONE 14px --steel summary line (summaryText) — never a card.
The week strip as the primary control — it becomes the 7-cell ledger, day initial as the tab label.
Logged ticks, intensity/load encoding and today marking — restated in the ledger grammar (mark row, load mark, 2px --signal today rule).
The selected day's session set — SessionCard(s), now via the carousel at narrow widths.
Deep links: /week?day=3 selects on load; the '‹ Today' back link stays.
delete: The entire 'This week' section at apps/web/src/routes/week/+page.svelte:111-130 (SectionHeader + Card + 7-row ul). It repeats the strip's days, sessions, intensity ladders and distances and costs ~200-260px on the exact screen that reads too vertical.
The standalone week-pager row (lines 78-84): two bordered 40px buttons plus a whole line for one number. The pager moves into the header line.
The three-row back/title block (lines 72-76): '‹ Today' becomes the top-left mono link on the pager line; PLAN becomes the eyebrow on the title line.
The global footer domain line under the fixed tab bar (unreachable, duplicates the install origin).
The bordered-chip chevron styling on the week pager — replaced by mono text controls with a hairline underline on hover/press.
The vertical space-y-3 stack of per-session cards on multi-session days (replaced by the carousel below 720px).
week.replace:
One object replaces both the strip and the list: a 7-cell 'week ledger' inside a single --sunken well.
Each cell (1/7 width, min 48x64, roving tabindex, role='tab'):
  L1  mono 10px day initial (MO..SU), --steel; --ink when selected
  L2  a 2px load mark, 4-28px tall, height = day minutes / week max; rest day = a 2px --hairline tick (no empty hole, no zero-height bar)
  L3  mono 9px total ('45' / '-' on rest), --steel
  L4  marks: x logged (--signal-ink), * planned (--ink), x* = one of two done; two sessions render two marks side by side
Selected: cell returns to --paper + 1px --hairline-strong (raised out of the sunken well) + --ink text. Today: 2px --signal rule on the cell's bottom edge and '(today)' in the accessible name; the two can co-exist.
Below: ONE selected day, never seven — 'WEDNESDAY / 2 SESSIONS / 50 MIN' then carousel (n>=2), single card (n==1), or the rest block (n==0).
Whole screen: header (2 rows) -> ledger (1 band) -> selected day (1 block). No second list.
The deleted list's content still exists for screen readers as the tabpanel description: 'Wednesday: 2 sessions, 50 minutes, 1 of 2 logged — Threshold 5 x 1 km, Upper body A.' Announced once, not drawn as seven duplicate rows.
week.tab_or_view:
A focused VIEW, not a fourth tab.
- Keep three tabs. A 4th would break the act / ask / measure rhythm, give a scan surface the same standing as the day's action, and squeeze each tab to ~97px at 390 (forcing contractions or smaller mono).
- Enter from Today: the Today header's mono 'W3 / 12' line and the mini week strip link to /week?day=<day>. The view keeps '‹ Today' and the back stack.
- On /week no tab is current: all three read --steel (inactive). That is honest — the view sits above the tabs. Do not fake-select Today and do not add a 4th mark.

motion: Carousel: no authored animation. Native scroll + CSS snap only. Cards never scale, fade, or parallax on snap — a scaling 'active' card changes type size mid-gesture and reads as a gallery, not an instrument.
Keyboard / programmatic carousel move: scrollTo smooth, 240ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); behavior:'auto' under prefers-reduced-motion.
Tick rail: active tick 12->24px, 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1). The '01 / 02' index never animates (cross-fading digits is noise).
Tab notch: 140ms transform cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), x only; no width morph, no spring, no bounce. Colour changes 120ms linear.

Week ledger selection: 120ms background-color / border-color (sunken -> paper); load marks never animate on week change. Day change below: opacity .6->1 and translateY 2px->0 over 120ms ease-out, removed entirely under reduced motion.
Press: 90ms opacity/background, no scale, no ripple. Sheets keep their existing 180ms translateY + 160ms scrim; do not add a spring.
Nothing animates on scroll, in the tab bar, or on route change. prefers-reduced-motion removes every authored transform; colour changes become instant.
self_critique: The risk was answering 'too vertical' by adding a third horizontal band (strip + overview + carousel). I merged strip and overview into one ledger, so the fix deletes a row instead of relocating it. Cost: 7 cells must carry initial, load, minutes and state at ~48px. If that fails legibility, drop the minutes line — never reintroduce the list.

Rejected the stock carousel vocabulary: dots (lie at n=1, encode nothing), a scaled active card (type size shifts mid-snap), card shadows and a blurred floating pill tab bar. This system is paper + hairline on a ground; elevation would contradict both the no-shadow rule and the sunken/paper meaning.

The 40px peek shows only the next card's spine and gutter — never a clipped word. That is less inviting than a content peek and can look like a bug in a screenshot; the 2px modality edge and hairline must make it read as a second card. At 320px the peek drops to 28px and gets tight.
Equal-height cards leave dead space in a short strength card. Accepted: a stable action-row baseline is worth more than a tight card, otherwise Start jumps vertically on every snap.

The ruler tab bar risks reading as under-designed at first glance. Intentional, but the three 20px marks must stay distinguishable with square caps; if Today's notch blurs into Progress's ladder, add a fourth bar to Progress rather than thickening strokes.

Mono 10px labels with .12em tracking contradict platform tab bars (11-12px sans). It buys the instrument voice and clears 4.5:1 in both themes, at a small cost in glance recognition that always-visible labels offset.
Week as a focused view means no tab reads current on /week. Honest but visually unanchored; '‹ Today', the title and the URL carry location. Faking a current tab would misreport the page.

Amber discipline: notch, carousel tick and today rule are the only amber on these three surfaces; amber never fills a button and never sets text. Three amber marks on one screen could read as decoration — they sit on different surfaces and each maps to one state, but audit this first in build.

The carousel keeps off-screen cards focusable, so tabbing can pull the strip sideways under a user who never intended to swipe. The focusin scroll keeps semantics honest; the alternative (aria-hidden off-screen cards) hides reachable content from AT and is worse.

I did not touch the Today page's own stacked sections beyond the session set; if Today still reads long after this, the next lever is the week-progress widget and the WhyCard, not more compression here.
